observations: Photo shows only a cardboard shipping box, not the camera itself.
Box has a yellow 'Nikon' sticker and 'D800' printed in black on the side.
Background shows other camera boxes (an 'Olympus' box and a 'Kodak EasyShare' box), suggesting a shop/stock shelf rather than a single private seller's item.
A faint watermark reads 'POSTED ON ... ANCHOR MEDIA', indicating this image may be a reposted/stock photo rather than an original photo of the seller's actual unit.

claims.claim: UK used Nikon D800 DSLR full frame camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a sealed-looking box with no visible wear, opened flaps, or camera body; 'used' condition cannot be confirmed and the sealed appearance contradicts a 'used' claim.

claims.claim: Item is a Nikon D800 (model identity)
claims.evidence: Only the box label is visible; no body, mount, or serial plate shown to confirm the actual contents match the box.

risks.risk: Box may not contain an actual working Nikon D800 (could be empty, a different/cheaper body, or a non-functional unit).
risks.proof: Photo of the camera body removed from the box, showing the Nikon D800 nameplate, lens mount, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition/functionality unverified, i.e. worst case as non-working or mismatched item

risks.risk: Shutter count and sensor condition unknown, critical for a high-megapixel full-frame body like the D800.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a shutter-count app reading.

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/reposted image ('ANCHOR MEDIA' watermark) rather than the seller's actual item, raising risk of bait-and-switch.
risks.proof: A fresh, timestamped photo of the actual box and camera in the seller's possession, ideally with a handwritten note or date.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified listing authenticity, priced conservatively

risks.risk: No image of included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) claimed or shown.
risks.proof: Photo of full kit contents laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual camera body out of the box, showing front, top LCD, and lens mount.
Photo of the serial number sticker/plate on the camera body.
Photo or video showing the camera powering on and shutter firing.
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu.
Photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, strap, box contents laid out).
response.reason: Only the outer box is shown with no image of the actual camera body, serial number, or functionality, so even a worst-case price cannot be set until the real item is photographed.
